calls.thesis: Grouped in with the neoclouds in this video: a capex-heavy name that has had a terrible run over the past year. Neocloud doom loop: Anthropic revenue growth has stalled month-on-month (~+1.8% over the past 4 weeks after +46% QoQ in Q3), corporate AI spend is being capped, and CoreWeave's 2031 debt yield has risen from ~8% in May to over 15%, so new capital is too expensive to build data centres profitably; he is not in this part of the AI trade and expects some of these stocks to keep collapsing.
calls.price_at_call: Down about 9% over the past 5 days at Friday's recording (no share price stated)

calls.thesis: Reiterated: 'the only one that I would say definitely avoid' — legacy software drag, only 32% expected revenue growth; the 2.4GW New Mexico data-center delay/force majeure is 'the first crack in the AI trade'.

Valuation mirage: AI capex boom hides -$28B TTM free cash flow and ~$120B debt; 10-yr borrowing cost rose 5.7% (Feb) to ~7.3%; Project Jupiter force majeure shows execution strain. -53% over past year with more downside ahead.
Force majeure on the 2.5GW New Mexico data center could be 'the first crack in the entire AI boom'; worst of the neo-cloud group, -53% since May, -5.1x debt-to-FCF.
